hypothesis: Seven rounds of edits inside the stage modules (ex_stage operand latch, mem_stage dmem_valid/dmem_wdata, hazard_unit load-use flush, forwarding_unit priority) all failed to move the same checks, which points at the boundary that every stage fix must cross: the top-level rv32i5.sv wiring. The store data and forwarding results that the stage fixes compute are not what actually reaches the external ports. At the top, dmem_wdata/dmem_addr/dmem_we appear to be driven from a raw EX/MEM register field (exmem_rs2_data / exmem_alu_result) instead of from mem_stage's post-forwarding store-data output, and the forwarding_unit outputs (ex_rs1_data/ex_rs2_data) are not routed into ex_stage's operand inputs (they are left on the pre-forwarded idex_rs1_data/idex_rs2_data). The net observable effect is exactly the residual symptoms: any consumer whose operand comes from the immediately preceding producer reads a stale 0, so in t08 the SB/SH of x7 (=0x7aa) land as 0x00 producing 0xa5a5a500/0xa5a50000 and x7 itself reads back 0; in t07 the dependent store never issues a real write (DMEM write count 0), DMEM[0x10c] stays at the preset 0xa5a5a5a5 so x12 reads 0xa5a5a5a5 and x3/x13 read 0. Independently, dmem_valid at the top is still a combinational function of an un-initialized EX/MEM valid without rst_n participating at the actual output mux, so it is X before the first reset edge and power_on_reset fails.
constraints: Keep the rv32i5 top-level port list, widths and names exactly as frozen in the spec.
Do not change stage-module port contracts (id_stage/ex_stage/mem_stage/hazard_unit/forwarding_unit signatures are frozen).
dmem_valid must be a combinational AND that includes rst_n (X & 0 = 0) so it is 0 strictly before and during reset.
Load/store remain single-cycle no-wait-state; only load-use and control redirects may stall.
Bubble/flush must be expressed by clearing valid bits, never by data values.
rd=x0 writes must be discarded; halted/exit_code must latch at ECALL WB commit and freeze the pipeline.
dmem_we=1 only for stores; dmem_be derived from mem_size and addr[1:0].
The store data reaching dmem_wdata must be the forwarding-resolved operand (memwb/EX-MEM forwarded), not the raw ID-stage regfile read.
verification_targets: power_on_reset: dmem_valid == 0 (not X) on every sample before the first reset edge.
t08_store_fwd: after SB the word reads 0xa5a5a5aa and after SH 0xa5a507aa (currently 0xa5a5a500 and 0xa5a50000), so x8 == 0xa5a5a5aa and x9 == 0xa5a507aa.
